items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: The only real professor I had, like I said, was Mr. Piran.

ctx.x: And I thought he was laughing at me. So I didn't go back then anymore. So Bonnie saw me about a month late. He says, how come you haven't been back to lessons, old Papa, asking about you? Or I said, Bonnie, you sitting over there laughing at me. I said, I can't learn anything. He said, I wasn't laughing. He says, I do that on account of some sand in my nose that I got when I was swimming. Oh, I said, well, I'm not going back anyhow. So a thought struck me then that I better go on and learn some music somewhere…
Natty had to do that with Manuel Perez.
